notablePrerequisites: Animar has at least one +1/+1 counter on it.
description:
Cast Endless One, choosing one for X, but paying {0} due to Animar.
Animar triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on itself.
Endless One enters the battlefield, triggering Cloudstone Curio, returning Ugin's Conjurant from the battlefield to your hand.
Cast Ugin's Conjurant, choosing one for X, but paying {0} due to Animar.
Animar triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on itself.
Ugin's Conjurant enters the battlefield, triggering Cloudstone Curio, returning Endless One from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.
